title: card-authoring rules live in the repository and the checker enforces them: a merge intent card carries every intent field and a plain MERGE CARD / 【合併卡】 title, every intent card maps each intent item to its mechanism and evidence in done, the before/after nodes draw how the change works, and only the captain's click answers a merge card
acceptance: Why. On 2026-10-06 the captain corrected firstmate's card authoring four times: a merge card must keep all intent-card details and must say plainly that it is a merge card ('merge卡不要這樣改, 要有全部細節, 只要明顯告知這是派工卡還是合併卡就好'); the before/after diagram must explain how the change works, not only its effect ('digram不要只畫你做出來的效果是什麼, 要說明你是怎麼做的'); the card must show how the result aligns with the original intent ('跟當初的意圖怎麼對齊的'); and these are repository rules, not firstmate's private memory ('這是規則不是記憶'). Firstmate had kept them only in ~/.claude memory. Today skills/firstmate/SKILL.md:776-781 requires the intent fields on dispatch, merge and scope cards but says nothing about a merge label, mechanism diagrams or intent alignment, and bin/lib/fm_ste.py check-details (:180-217, CLI :220-243, usage :225 'fm_ste.py rules | check-details <file>') does not know a card's kind. Line numbers are on main 2428fee; named code wins.

Change 1, the checker learns the card kind (bin/lib/fm_ste.py). The CLI becomes `fm_ste.py rules | check-details [--kind <kind>] <file>` (update the usage string at :225). `check_details(details, kind=None)` keeps every current rule. When kind is `merge` or `merge-untracked` and the details are an intent card (`_validate` returns True), it also requires, in both locales: every one of `intent`, `why`, `scope_in`, `scope_out`, `done`, `questions`, `before_nodes`, `after_nodes`, `change_table` present (`notes` stays optional), and the title label: `en.title` starts with `MERGE CARD — ` (U+2014 em dash, single spaces) and `zh-TW.title` starts with `【合併卡】`. A missing field or a missing label is a malformed card: raise ValueError naming the locale and field (for example `en.title: a merge card title starts with "MERGE CARD — "`), so the CLI exits 64 as for other shape errors. Merge details without any intent field (legacy, `_validate` False) keep today's behaviour and report `{"intent_card": false}`: decide.test.sh requests about thirty legacy merge cards and the board renders legacy cards; SKILL.md already forbids dropping the intent fields to bypass the checker. A kind other than merge/merge-untracked (choice, or omitted) adds nothing from this change except Change 2.

Change 2, intent alignment in `done` (bin/lib/fm_ste.py). For every intent card, whatever the kind: for each intent item N (1-based, by position in that locale's `intent` array), the same locale's `done` array holds at least one item whose text starts with `Intent N:` (en) or `意圖 N：` / `意圖 N:` (zh-TW; full-width or ASCII colon, a single ASCII space between 意圖 and the number). Other `done` items (for example 'CI, review and the six gates are green on this head.') stay allowed. This makes `done` required on every intent card (today only `intent` is required, fm_ste.py:139-147): an intent card without `done` in a locale raises ValueError `<locale>.done: required on an intent card`, exit 64; a card with `done` present in one locale only keeps the existing both-or-neither error. A missing alignment item raises ValueError naming the locale and the intent number (for example `zh-TW.done: no alignment item for 意圖 2`), exit 64. Why `done` and not a new `alignment` field: `done` is already authored on every intent card, already rendered by the board as its done-when section (board/public/index.html:833, `sentences('done','doneWhen')`), already STE-checked sentence by sentence (fm_ste.py:210-212), and already capped at 12 items like `intent`; a new field would need board rendering, and board/ is out of scope while T-222/T-227 change it. The alignment item states the mechanism step that meets the intent and its evidence, for example 'Intent 2: the push uses --force-with-lease with the bound PR head. Test case 1 proves it.'; the checker verifies only the prefix, not the claim (manual review, see Change 4).

Change 3, fm-decide passes the kind (bin/fm-decide.sh). The request-time call at :412 becomes `python3 "$HERE/lib/fm_ste.py" check-details --kind "$KIND" "$DETAILS"`; exit handling at :413-421 is unchanged (64 and 65 pass through, nothing is written). The check stays where it is, after the details-shape and effect checks and before `pr_agrees` and `fm_binding candidate`, so a refused merge card makes no GitHub call. Callers of check-details: bin/fm-decide.sh:412 (this change), tests/ste.test.sh:14, firstmate by hand per SKILL.md:771. Callers of `fm-decide.sh --request`: bin/lib/fm_autopilot_loop.py:430 (merge cards from firstmate-authored state/decision-details/<id>.json; those files are firstmate's and must follow the new rules — the autopilot's existing attention path reports a refused request; no code change there), bin/fm.sh:717 (skill-update choice cards, legacy details, unaffected), tests/decide.test.sh, tests/skill-update-cards.test.sh, tests/decisions.test.sh, tests/board-readiness.test.sh, tests/board-card-effects.test.sh, tests/lib/evidence_binding.py, tests/lib/autopilot_cases.py, tests/lib/autopilot_loop.py. Of these only tests/decide.test.sh (:66-97, fixtures from tests/lib/ste_cases.py) sends intent-card details; the others send legacy details or write pending records directly (board-card-effects.test.sh:498 edits a pending record with jq, not through --request) and need no change — the worker confirms each with grep and says so.

Change 4, the rules in skills/firstmate/SKILL.md, edited in place in '## Author and verify captain decisions' (:702 onward) next to the intent-card paragraph at :776-781, and the checker line at :771 updated to `check-details --kind <kind> <file>`. State: (a) a merge card carries the full intent-card details like the dispatch card it follows, never a stripped summary, and its title begins `【合併卡】合併 PR #N：` / `MERGE CARD — merge PR #N: ` (enforced; `questions` is therefore mandatory on a merge intent card, so the paragraph at :779 that says 'questions for anything you are unsure of' adds that a merge card always asks at least one question); dispatch cards begin `派工` / `Dispatch`, repin cards `重新固定` / `Repin` (a writing rule, checked by eye; T-227 adds a recorded card purpose and a board badge, and this task does not touch that); (b) `before_nodes`/`after_nodes` draw how the change works — the mechanism as an ordered flow of steps (components, checks, actions), with `gone` and `new` marking the steps that leave and arrive — not only the visible result (checked by eye: the checker cannot judge meaning); (c) each intent item has an alignment item in `done` naming `Intent N`/`意圖 N`, the mechanism step and its evidence (prefix enforced, content checked by eye); (d) firstmate never answers a merge card: only the captain's board click merges. Rewrite :331-332 ('Firstmate answers merge cards only inside the current recorded window; check its expiry before each answer, and stop when it ends even if a wake is delayed.') in place to say the recorded window is the captain's stated merge period that the autopilot reports on, and that firstmate does not answer merge cards in or out of it; nothing enforces (d) mechanically, because the board cannot tell a click from a firstmate POST with the same board secret — say so. Keep the existing rule at :459-462 (one merge card at a time per project) and add one sentence there that the autopilot already enforces it through `merge_blocker` (bin/lib/fm_concurrent.py:241) and firstmate's hand-raised cards follow it too. Firstmate's ~/.claude memory is not part of this task.

Not enforced in fm-decide.sh: one pending merge card per project. A refusal in `--request --kind merge` while another merge card of the project is pending would break tests/decide.test.sh, whose shared store `$o` raises several merge and merge-untracked cards in sequence (for example :576, :584, :609, :645, :658), and it would block re-raising a card while a superseded one is still pending. The autopilot path already holds the turn with `merge_blocker`/`merge_turn` (fm_concurrent.py:241-271). The worker leaves fm-decide.sh's request path otherwise unchanged.

Design. Edit design/design.md §5.2 'Captain decisions' in place, in the paragraph that starts 'Intent cards add optional locale fields (T-210)' and the one after it about `check-details` (:381-399): change the wording that calls `done` optional so it says `done` is required on an intent card and holds the alignment items, and add that `check-details --kind` requires every intent field and the MERGE CARD / 【合併卡】 title label on a merge intent card, that every intent card's `done` holds one `Intent N`/`意圖 N` alignment item per intent item, that legacy details still bypass, and that already-pending cards are not re-checked. Also edit §15.8 in place, under '#### Recorded chat merge windows (T-182)' (:5523): replace the sentence at :5531 'Firstmate answers board merge cards only within that recorded window.' with: the window is the captain's stated merge period that the autopilot reports on; firstmate answers no merge card, in or out of a window — only the captain's board click merges; nothing enforces this mechanically, because a firstmate POST with the board secret looks like a click. Keep the next sentence ('This is an evidence/timer facility, never a merge bypass or a replacement for gates.'). Do not append a section to the end of the file.

Migration. Records already in state/pending and state/decisions are never re-checked; the rules apply at the next `--request`. Details files that firstmate already wrote under state/decision-details/ but has not requested must be rewritten to the new rules before the autopilot requests them, or the request exits 64 and the autopilot reports it; firstmate checks each with `python3 bin/lib/fm_ste.py check-details --kind merge <file>` after this merges. The STE fixture tests/lib/ste_cases.py `card()` appends, after today's done item (done[0] stays 'The check passes.' / '檢查通過。'), the alignment items en `Intent 1: The check passes.` and zh-TW `意圖 1：檢查通過。` as done[1], so the 'pass' and request fixtures stay valid and the observations that overwrite `done[0]` (ste_cases.py:110-113, 'checks split done') still reach the STE check instead of a ValueError.

Tests (fail-first; fail-first runs only *.test.sh, so every new assertion is in a bash suite). tests/ste.test.sh, using new modes in tests/lib/ste_cases.py `fixture()`: (1) `align-missing` — intent has two items, done aligns only Intent 1 → exit 64 and stderr names `en.done` and `Intent 2`; (2) `align-zh` — zh-TW alignment uses `意圖 1:` with an ASCII colon → exit 0; (3) `merge-full` — a merge intent card with every field and both title labels, run with `--kind merge` → exit 0 and `.intent_card and .ok`; (4) `merge-label` — same card without `【合併卡】` in zh-TW.title, `--kind merge` → exit 64 naming `zh-TW.title`; (5) `merge-missing` — merge card without `change_table` in both locales, `--kind merge-untracked` → exit 64 naming `change_table`; (6) the same `merge-missing` file without `--kind` → exit 0 (the field set is a merge rule only); (7) legacy details with `--kind merge` → exit 0 and `{"intent_card":false}`; (8) `check-details --kind` with no value → exit 64 and stderr contains the new usage text `check-details [--kind <kind>] <file>`. (12) `no-done` — an intent card (choice, no --kind) without `done` in both locales → exit 64 and stderr names `done`. tests/decide.test.sh: (9) `--request ... --kind merge` with the `merge-label` fixture exits 64, writes nothing to state/pending, and makes no gh call (the existing gh stub records calls; assert the log is empty); (10) `--request` (choice) with `align-missing` exits 64 and writes nothing; (11) the existing T-210 cases at :66-97 keep passing with the updated fixtures. Cases 1, 3-5, 7, 8, 9, 10 and 12 fail on main (7 and 8 because main rejects the `--kind` argument list with the old usage). Workers do not run suites; CI and the gates verify.

Done when: SKILL.md states rules (a)-(d) in place; check-details enforces the merge field set, the merge title labels and the alignment prefixes; fm-decide passes --kind; design §5.2 says so and §15.8 no longer says firstmate answers merge cards; tests 1-12 exist and the listed callers are unchanged except decide.test.sh and the STE fixture; no file outside the scope list changes (bin/fm-worker.sh, bin/lib/fm_onboard.py, bin/fm-project.sh and board/ stay untouched).
